testing.strategy: Acceptance testing (per proposal) plus layered automated testing.
critical_test_cases: Customer cannot read another customer's service requests (RLS).
Technician can only update work orders assigned to them.
Store manager sees low-stock notification after stock drops below reorder level.
Invoice balance updates after M-Pesa payment callback.
Quotation totals recalculate when line items change.
Realtime status change appears on customer mobile within 2 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end flow: create request -> assign -> quote -> approve -> work -> invoice -> pay -> feedback.
No P1 bugs open at UAT sign-off.
All PDFs render correctly with company branding.
